Concept & Intent

The thinking
behind the brand.

I aimed to create a refined and calming brand identity that reflects warmth, elegance, and craftsmanship. The brand is positioned as a premium handcrafted candle company, appealing to customers who value quality home fragrances, minimalist aesthetics, and intentional living.

With this project, I wanted to demonstrate my ability to create premium lifestyle branding within the home fragrance industry while maintaining a cohesive visual identity across packaging and marketing materials — and to show that I can adapt my design approach to different industries and positioning while keeping every identity unique and strategically aligned.

About Malvine.

Malvine Candles is a home fragrance brand dedicated to creating luxurious, handcrafted candles using high-quality ingredients and timeless scents. Each piece is made to elevate your space and enhance your everyday rituals.
